title: Three-dimensional and axisymmetric stability of Hou's interior Navier-Stokes scenario: codes, data and record
description:
Code, logs and figure data for the paper A certified unstable eigenvalue of a columnar model of the front of Hou's Navier-Stokes collapse, and measured non-axisymmetric growth on the collapsing state.

Contents. The axisymmetric and azimuthal-mode solvers; the verified interval-arithmetic scripts behind Theorems 1 and 2, with their tests; the extraction scripts for the tables and figures; the comma-separated data behind Figures 1-3; the run logs; and the stage-B notes.

Start with REPRODUCE.md, which gives the commands and the numbers they should print. DATA_MANIFEST.md carries the snapshot hashes.

Not included, by size. The snapshots at the reported times are too large for the git repository and are archived here on Zenodo. The 5.8 GB stage-B block store is not deposited at all, and neither is the Galerkin eigenvector w of Theorem 2, which lives inside it; the repository gives the recipe and hashes to rebuild both, about 24 core-hours.

Corrections. RECORD.md lists every correction and retraction that touched a published number. These include the withdrawal of a Leibovich-Stewartson certificate whose criterion had been misstated; the scripts that produced it carry retraction headers and now compute the criterion as published.
